items.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – November 5th, 2026
items.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA： BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Nov 4th, 2026 23：00 (UTC) to Nov 5th, 2026 04：00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows：[/p][p]Brand New Content[/p][p]I. New Hero： Kael[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d2860b157950ecc306b846f27943d4848e3059c3.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever since merging his soul with Taotie, Kael, once an unremarkable disciple of the Herald, has wielded extraordinary power he can barely control.[/p][p]He began calling himself The One Who Eats Void and threw himself wholeheartedly into the grand cause of saving the world.[/p][p]But his soul and Taotie's are still not fully in sync, leaving him caught between ravenous bouts of gluttony and the constant struggle to keep his own desires in check![/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Wanchu Weapon： Bident[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/de06b4c7ed259879caed7731d8f024ecf086bc9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Legend has it that this weapon was forged by the 'merfolk', criminals exiled to the Deep Ocean by the Herald. An unusual weapon designed for underwater combat, it inherits the Herald's Prowess. A spiral mechanism between its twin prongs stirs up an undercurrent and conjures swirling curtains of water with each swing and thrust, briefly trapping foes and subduing them unseen.[/p][p]Can only be obtained in Wanchu - Dark Pearl Abyss. It requires water flow to launch an attack, so it's only usable in the water area.[/p][p]III. Showdown New Gameplay： Vanquisher's Trials[/p][p]A secret temple lies hidden on The Morus Isle. Those who enter its trials cannot bring their own weapons or souljades. Only by mastering the principles of martial arts can they stand against the powerful foes within. Only those who endure a hundred battles here can truly reach the pinnacle of martial mastery![/p][p]1. Rules[/p][p]・Vanquisher's Trials has two difficulties, Nightscream and Legend, each with three stages： Iron Sunder, Six Paths Trial, and Sandforge Tribulation. (Note： Trios mode does not automatically fill empty team slots. Form a team before attempting the challenge.)[/p][p]・In Vanquisher's Trials, you can only use preset heroes with their corresponding Souljade and Potential. Each stage offers 4 heroes to choose from.[/p][p]・Each stage has 4 Challenge quests. Completing each Challenge quest earns you 1 star. Accumulate enough stars to claim limited-time event rewards.[/p][p]· Legend mode will become available 1 week after the event begins. After that, a new Legend difficulty stage will unlock every 7 days.[/p][p]2. Rank Rewards[/p][p]・On legend difficulty, rankings are based on the best completion time for each stage, with separate rankings for solo and Trios.[/p][p]・After the event ends, players in the top 10, top 100, and top 500 of each leaderboard will receive limited-time title rewards.[/p][p]3. Showdown： Brand New Souljade[/p][p]1. Defuse·Surge： Increases Defuse (Counterattack) Damage, and increases your Critical Rate for a set period after a successful Defuse.[/p][p]2. Critical Transmutation： Reduces the effective Critical Rate cap from Souljade attributes and converts excess Critical Rate into Critical DMG.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Limited-time Event[/p][p]1. Martial Cutie：
Event Duration： After the update on Nov. 5th 2026 until Dec. 29th, 2026 at 16：00 (UTC)
Event Details：
1. During the event, players can obtain Paw Tally by completing Daily Quests and Weekly Quests.
2. Purchase Items to visit the pet Shop and purchase equipment for your pets to increase their Power!
3. You can challenge pet stages or use Matchmaking to spar with other players, and receive different rewards! You can also upgrade pets. Upgrading pets increases skill levels, Max Health, Bag size, and pet Power.
4. In this event, Molin is available by default. After clearing the pet stages The Morus Isle and Holoroth, you can unlock White Rabbit and Fire Pup respectively.
5. After the update on Nov. 19th, 2026, the new maps Stormchant and The Morus Isle·S will become available, along with Newly added pet equipment, unlocking more ways to Match equipment in battle! Clear the pet stage Stormchant to unlock Spirit Cat.
6. Obtaining 2 identical pet loadouts triggers an upgrade for that pet loadout. A single item can be upgraded to a maximum of 4 stars. All pet loadouts can be sold to the Shop for a 100% return in Paw Tally.[/p][p] [/p][p]Main updates this time：
1. Pet levels and Fatigue will be shared across all pets, rather than calculated separately for each pet.
2. Newly added \[Paw Leaderboard]： Rankings are based on Ranked Points in "Martial Cutie." Players on the leaderboard will receive title rewards when results are finalized.
3. Newly added pet \[Molin], with the exclusive skill \[Qilin Slash]： Grants \[Lifesteal] upon entering battle.
4. Newly added weapon type \[Heng Sword], with the exclusive mechanic \[Lethal Jab]： Triggers when a Charged Attack lands a hit, adding 1 extra Charged Attack that deals Damage equal to 0.5 times weapon ATK.
5. Newly added equipment and combat mechanics, along with adjustments to existing pet equipment effects, offer more ways to Match equipment in battle.
6. Pet stages have been completely revamped, with Newly added stage Omens.
7. Season Quests have been changed to Weekly Quests.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Devouring Breath[/p][p]Seize and devour beast souls to nourish yourself, and refine true Qi to achieve the grand cause![/p][p]Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p](1) During the event, complete Daily Quests and Weekly Quests to obtain Soulmeld Elixir. Submitting Soulmeld Elixir increases Chapter Progress, unlocking more chapters and stories.[/p][p](2) Chapters must be unlocked in sequential order. You can check \[Stories] at any time to view unlocked stories.[/p][p](3) Unlock all chapters to claim generous rewards including a Hero-exclusive Accessory, Devourer Treasure, and Serene Treasure Choice Gift.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Ashes of the Realm[/p][p]Through endless trials to ease mortal suffering, a lone blade shatters delusion to calm the storm.[/p][p]Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.[/p][p]2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.[/p][p]3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Cold Front's Aspirant[/p][p]Tempered through a thousand trials, the blade is forged; only at the martial peak can one claim supremacy.[/p][p]Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 Update - Nov. 18th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]During the event, you can gather the exclusive champion collection from the 2025 NARAKA： BLADEPOINT J Cup (Trios and Solo) to earn the champion team's avatars, signed cosmetics, and other rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Devourer Treasure with bonus Star - Collections for a limited time[/p][p]Event Duration： Nov. 5th, 2026 04：00 (UTC) - Nov. 20th, 2026 04：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]1. When opening Devourer Treasure, there is a chance to receive the Yoto Hime Extreme Collection \[Star - Null Pulse] and the Greatsword Legendary Collection \[Star - Null Vector].[/p][p]2. How to obtain： Each time you open a Devourer Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you open more Devourer treasures. The maximum chance is 100%.[/p][p]3. The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.[/p][p]4. Each account can receive a maximum of 10 \[Star - Null Pulse] and 2 \[Star - Null Vector].[/p][p]5. The number of Star-collections that can be obtained from Devourer treasures is limited. They are available only while supplies last.[/p][p]6. The Star-Collections granted through the Devourer Treasure are time-limited：[/p][p]\[Star - Null Pulse] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Nov. 6th, 2026 at 04：00 (UTC).[/p][p]\[Star - Null Vector] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Nov. 20th, 2026 at 04：00 (UTC).

Marketplace Adjustments
1. The character level required to list items has been increased from 10 to 50.
2. The cooldown before an item can be traded again has been increased from 24 hours to 48 hours.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #11
With swords in hand, free and bold while exploring the world, unrestricted and unhampered. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #11 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration： Nov. 5, 2026 20：00 (UTC) - Dec. 2, 2026 20：00 (UTC)

Event Duration： Nov. 5, 2026 00：00 (UTC) - Dec. 2, 2026 23：59 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Season Exclusive： Devourer Treasure[/p][p]1. The Devourer Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Kael Extreme Outfit \[Urban Hunt·Echofold Domain] and the Whipsword Extreme Skin \[Silent Frost].[/p][p]2. While wearing the \[Urban Hunt·Echofold Domain] Outfit, there will be an exclusive \[Data Devour] effect when you defeat enemies. Performing a Double Jump switches between Entropy mode and Dreadshade mode. This form cannot be imprinted.[/p][p]3. Equipping the \[Silent Frost] weapon Skin changes the Attack Effects of Counterstrike Combos and Souljade \[Sap]. Once you are out of combat, Silent Frost enters its Aquatic Blossom form.[/p][p]4. Minimum Guarantee：[/p][p](1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.[/p][p](2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee： Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.[/p][p](3) Wishing Legendary Reward： If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.[/p][p]5. 50% Discount on the first 10 Devourer Treasure openings.[/p][p]The first 10 Devourer Treasures that you open will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Devourer Treasures have been opened, subsequent Devourer Treasures will undergo a rollback to their Standard price.[/p][p]6. Devourer Treasure will be available on Nov. 5th at 04：00 (UTC)![/p][p]After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Devourer Treasures will remain locked until the specified time.[/p][p]The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Spring Lantern·Hua.[/p][p]VI. Collection Rotation： Removals[/p][p]The 2023 J Cup·Champion Collection items will be removed from sale on Dec. 30th at 00：00 (UTC). From Nov. 19th to Dec. 30th, we will offer discounts on selected Collections from this series and bring back selected Collections from previous Champion tournaments. Stay tuned![/p][p]The following collections will no longer be available：[/p][p]Champion Forged·Shepherd of Torrents, Champion Forged·LYD, Champion Forged·Wind Guardian, Champion Forged·VVV, Champion Forged·Ethereal Glow, Champion Forged·Leo, Champion Forged·Dire Omen, Champion Forged·TXJ, Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Scepter, Champion Forged·Aetherwing, Champion Forged·Evilbreaker, Champion Forged·Heaven and Earth, Champion Forged·Vastview, Champion Forged·Sandalwood, Champion Forged·Scales, Champion Forged·Pride, Champion Forged·Shimmer Tail, Champion Forged·Shimmer Wings, Champion Forged·Dragon Horns, Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Crown, The Breaker·Bumblebee, The Breaker·Bumblebee Dog, Champion Forged·Feathered Victory, The Breaker·Mike, 2023TE, 2023AOW.[/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Showdown Event Level \[Demonbane Realm] Returns[/p][p]Event Duration： Nov. 4th, 2026 20：00 (UTC) to Dec. 2nd, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p](1) During the event, you can select this level on the Showdown Map. Complete each event challenge to get an exclusive Hero Badge, Breakthrough Aura, Exhilarating Elixir and other rewards. This time, the original Carved Crystal and Souljade Fragment rewards have been replaced with a Showdown Material Choice Gift.[/p][p]//Dev Note： Showdown Material Choice Gifts allow players to replenish whichever materials they need, giving them more flexibility in managing progression resources.[/p][p]2) Showdown Level in the event will not impact damage dealt or received, and the event levels are split into two chapters. A new rating system has been added, along with many combat items and interactive mechanisms.[/p][p]Rating System： Team rating is determined by the performance of all players. While basic actions like damage dealing contribute to the team's score, advanced techniques like Counter and Defuse are essential for achieving higher ratings. There are 5 tiers of ratings： C, B, A, S, and SS. Rating decreases over time.[/p][p]Navigation： After defeating a Boss, airstreams appear to transport you to the next battlefield. If you fall from an airstream, use a Rising Wind mechanism to take off again, or use a Summon Stone mechanism to teleport to the battlefield.[/p][p]· Environmental interactions： Attacks cause Crimson Mist to release red Toxic Mist. Contact with it briefly increases attack Damage but inflicts the \[Toxified] status; each time the Thunderstorm Array opens, it creates a circular Thunder Array centered on itself, dealing Thundershock Damage. This can be blocked with a Counter; the Ice Mound can be attacked and recovers on its own, periodically launching frost attacks at nearby heroes.[/p][p](3) The two chapters share the same loots including：[/p][p]Items \[Carved Crystal], \[Phase Rune][/p][p]Souljade \[Critical Transmutation] \[Pyreheart] \[Venom Tempering] \[Primal Starfall] \[Ice Ring Break] \[Thunder Rove] \[Defuse·Surge] \[Star-Shattering Force] \[Polesword·Blistering Edge][/p][p](4) Each chapter has two difficulty stages that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. For heroes who use special weapons after activating their Ultimate, including Yoto Hime, Ye Xiu, Yueshan (Almighty General), and Inor Wan (Thunder Lord)：[/p][p]Optimized the impact effects of their basic underwater horizontal and Vertical Strike attacks so that enemies' hit reactions better reflect underwater physics.[/p][p]2. The Vajra, Bronze Mech, Xunhuan Li in Flying Knives Aim mode, and Cyra in her Ultimate state can Jump repeatedly while underwater.[/p][p]IV. Other Adjustments[/p][p]1. Newly added the \[Hard Control] skill tag. Control effects from skills with the \[Hard Control] tag can affect Ultimate Focus, as well as the Bronze Mech and the Vajra.[/p][p]・Includes skills： \[Moonbane Control], \[Rising Tide], \[Enchant], \[Light's Mercy： Field], \[Fate Rewritten： Backtrack], and \[Maw of Ruin].[/p][p]Souljade Adjustments[/p][p]1. Polesword Souljade[/p][p]1. Optimized the reactions to the attacks from \[Thunder Portal][/p][p] [/p][p]The Herald's Trial Rank and Points Rule Adjustments[/p][p]I. Newly Added Ranks[/p][p]1. The minimum rank score in The Herald's Trial has been adjusted from 1,000 to 0 points.[/p][p]2. Newly added two ranks below Bronze： \[Plain Stone] (0 - 499 points) and \[Gray Lead] (500 - 999 points).[/p][p]II. Earn Rank Points in Quick Match[/p][p]1. Rank points have been updated. Quick Match and Ranked Mode now share Rank Points.[/p][p]2. Quick Match only awards points and never deducts them, allowing you to reach up to 1,500 points.[/p][p]3. After reaching 1,500 Rank points, play Ranked Mode to continue earning more.[/p][p]III. Hero Score Adjustments[/p][p]1. Quick Match now also grants Hero Score for The Herald's Trial, with the calculation capped at 1,500 points.[/p][p]2. Playing Quick Match will not deduct Hero Score.[/p][p]IV. Rerank Challenge Adjustments[/p][p]1. Unranked players can still play Quick Match, but it will not progress the Rerank Challenge.[/p][p]2. The Rerank Challenge must still be completed through Ranked Mode.[/p][p]3. Added a new trigger condition for the Rerank Challenge： players must reach at least 1,500 points in The Herald's Trial. The Rerank Challenge will no longer place players in Bronze rank. Players who have already unlocked Ranked Mode and triggered the Rerank Challenge can still complete it.[/p][p]V. Points Carryover Rules[/p][p]1. Players who have unlocked Ranked Mode will retain their existing Rank Points in Solo, Duos, and Trios.[/p][p]2. Players who have not unlocked Ranked Mode will receive initial Rank Points based on their account level before the update, ranging from 0 to 1,000 points.[/p][p]3. Below 1,000 points, Solo, Duos, and Trios share Rank Points, and no points are deducted. Above 1,000 points, points are tracked separately for each mode.[/p][p]In-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Wanchu Adjustments[/p][p]1. Cerulean Crystal Palace and its surrounding buildings have risen above the water. The water depth in Dark Pearl Abyss has been reduced to 35m.[/p][p]Dev Note： Legend has it that when Nuxin raised Wanchu from the seabed, the Dark Pearl Abyss in the bottom-right corner could not fully surface. It was pinned down by the "Heaven-Supporting Jade Pillar." Over time, however, the seal has gradually loosened.[/p][p]2. Adjusted the distribution of resources and Soul Altars in Dark Pearl Abyss.[/p][p]3. Slightly increased the chance of Starry Night weather occurring.[/p][p]4. Increased the number of Golden Flame and Violet Coralline spawns, and reduced the number of Coralline Branch items required to craft Armor.[/p][p]5. Simplified rock formations in several locations to make movement and climbing easier.[/p][p]II. The Evolution Adjustments[/p][p]1. Increased the EXP and BP EXP gain rates for Defeats, Rescues, and Damage in The Evolution;[/p][p]2. Increased the chance of obtaining Epic and Legendary Technique rewards after winning in the Realm of Yang;[/p][p]3. Increased the quantity and spawn rate of \[Valiant Challenge] and \[Bounty] Quest Scrolls in The Evolution;[/p][p]4. Increased the EXP and BATTLEPASS EXP gain rates in The Evolution.[/p][p]Out-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Talents Feature Optimization[/p][p]Talents can now be modified during th preparation stage.[/p][p]Newly added a "Change Potential" button to the existing Glyph Plan switching interface. Tap this button to open the adjustment interface.[/p][p]Each change is saved immediately and will also carry over to your out-of-match settings or your next match.[/p][p]II. World Chat Channel Optimization[/p][p]Increased the maximum number of players who can chat simultaneously in the World Chat channel.[/p][p]III. Profile Interface Adjustments[/p][p]Newly added Martial Artist Duel·Competition statistics to the My Info and Season Stats interfaces.[/p][p]The highest win streak and average Damage per match for this mode only count matches played after this update. Historical data from before the update is excluded.[/p][h1][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Kaleidoscope Parasol[/p][p]1. The final hit of the Parasol-form charged Horizontal Strike move now knocks airborne enemies farther away.
2. Reduced the stagger inflicted on knocked-down enemies by the \[Kaleidoscope·Shift] moves in all forms.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. In-game Gameplay Optimization[/p][p]1. Adjusted some quests on the Stormchant Bulletin Board.[/p][p]2. Optimized the interaction prompts for \[Treasure Coffin]. The opener's priority looting period has been adjusted to 30 sec.[/p][p]3. On the Stormchant map, reduced the time required to open \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] in the Cave.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Weekly Contract Reward Adjustments[/p][p]The Advanced Century Chest Trial Card reward from Weekly Contract has been replaced with a Storage Choice Gift. Open it to choose either an Advanced Century Chest or an Advanced Key Case.[/p][p] [/p][p]Showdown Adjustments[/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. Adjustments to Viper Ning's Ultimate \[Moonbane Control： Showdown]：[/p][p]① Newly added effect： Summons \[Moonbane's Eye] to gaze at nearby enemies for 25 sec. During this time, \[Moonbane's Breath] continuously surges forth to strike gazed enemies. Hitting an enemy with an Aegis-break Martial Skill or Defuse (Counterattack) triggers an additional \[Moonbane's Breath].[/p][p]② Viper Ning is immune to Freezing during summoning.[/p][p]③ Viper Ning's Ultimate cannot be canceled midway.[/p][p]2. Adjusted Yueshan's skill \[Rampage： Showdown] while in Almighty General form： After a hit on an enemy, he can instantly perform his exclusive Charged Attack.[/p][p]3. Adjusted the damage multiplier of Yueshan's charged heavy strike in Almighty General form from 20 to 30[/p][p]4. The effect of the \[Thunder Rove] Souljade has been changed to： "When your team's Thundershock Meter is full, the summoned Divine Thunder can be Countered and no longer causes Stagger. Divine Thunder reflected by a Counter strikes back and forth in a straight line. Increases Elemental Accumulation efficiency by 60%. (Incompatible with Souljade： \[Thunder Counter])"[/p][p]5. Increased the Damage Multiplier of all basic Defuse (Counterattack) moves to 3 times their previous values and reduced their Astral Aegis multipliers to 50% of their previous values. These changes improve the overall Damage output and Astral Aegis Damage performance of Defuse (Counterattack).[/p][p]II. Function Adjustments[/p][p]1. Optimized Souljade Deconstruction[/p][p]When deconstructing an individual Souljade in your inventory, you can now directly deconstruct it even if it is equipped or locked.[/p][p] [/p][p]Feature Adjustments[/p][p]I. Client[/p][p]1. Refactored the game's underlying resource-loading mechanism, significantly reducing main-thread stuttering during heavy loading for smoother loading and more stable performance.[/p][p] [/p][p]Store Updates[/p][p]I. items.title: NARAKA：BLADEPOINT Update –October 22nd, 2026
items.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA：BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from October 21st, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC) to October 22nd, 2026 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p]Brand New Content[/p][p] [/p][p]New Chapter in Rift Traversal：Stormchant, Hongmen Banquet[/p][p]As the Qin dynasty fell, Xiang Yu crushed its armies at Julu, overawing the feudal lords. Liu Bang entered Guanzhong first, guarding Hangu Pass and encamping at Bashang. Upon hearing that "the Duke of Pei intends to rule Guanzhong," Xiang Yu flew into a rage and planned to attack the next day. Knowing he stood no chance, Liu Bang went to Hongmen to apologize. During the banquet, Fan Zeng had Xiang Zhuang perform a sword dance to assassinate Liu Bang. Liu Bang had no choice but to excuse himself and escape along a side path...[/p][p]I. In-game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Activity：\[Preparing the Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Outerworld 2 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Gameplay Info:[/p][p]1) Return the scattered dining tables, seats, long tables, and other furnishings to their places to set up this important banquet.[/p][p]2) Once preparations are complete, you can claim a Crate reward and take a seat at the banquet to receive 1 additional reward.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Activity：\[Hongmen Banquet]. Spawns in the Innerworld 8 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Activity Overview：Dark undercurrents stir at the Hongmen Banquet. The hero must stay vigilant at all times and resolve Fan Zeng and Xiang Zhuang's treacherous plots against Liu Bang.[/p][p]1) Stage 1：Use a Blue Focus Strike to interrupt Fan Zeng's \[At the Drop of a Cup]. Successfully stopping him grants rewards and reduces the number of attacks Xiang Zhuang launches.[/p][p]2) Stage 2：Use Counter to block the repeated deadly attacks aimed at Liu Bang during \[Xiang Zhuang's Sword Dance].[/p][p]3) Receive 1-3 Crate rewards based on Liu Bang's remaining health at the end.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Activity：\[Escape from Hongmen]. Spawns in the Innerworld 11 minutes after the match begins.[/p][p]Activity：Liu Bang leaves the Hongmen Banquet on a pretext. The hero must escort him past the pursuing Chu Soldiers and back to the Han Camp. Reach the destination to receive a Crate reward.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Newly Added In-Match Mechanisms[/p][p]1. Rewind Device[/p][p]After activating the device, offer Relics worth the required value to reset Lootable Containers within range once the countdown ends. Eligible containers：Lootable Containers, \[Legendary Crates], and \[Epic Crates] (excluding Crates obtained from Caves, quests, or puzzles).[/p][p]2. Treasure Coffin[/p][p]Newly added the interactive Lootable Container \[Treasure Coffin] to the Stormchant map. Opening it requires the special key \[Coffin Crowbar], grants high-value Relics, and consumes \[Coffin Crowbar] durability. \[Coffin Crowbar] can be found during matches or obtained from the Trading Market.[/p][p]III. Xiling Seal Art Society Crossover[/p][p]1. New in-match gameplay added to the Stormchant map：Pick up a \[Seal Casket] in the Outerworld to unseal the map's August Banners and collect Duke of Pei Tokens. Collect any 3 to obtain a complete set of Stormchant Seals. You can then strike the zhu to play "Stormchant" for a chance to obtain the Xiling Seal Art Society crossover Relic \[Stormchant·Seal].[/p][p]2. Event Duration：Oct. 21st, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC) to Nov. 18th, 2026 at 23:00 (UTC). During the event, a progress bar is added at the bottom right of the Home screen：Crossover Collection·Stormchant·Seal. Search Lootable Containers in matches to fill the progress bar. When it's full, you're guaranteed to find a crossover collectible. After the event ends, you can still obtain these collectibles by searching containers.[/p][p]IV. New Camp Character[/p][p]1) Huang Jikao has left the camp. After completing the season quests \[A Letter from an Old Friend] and \[Visit the Sage], the camp will unlock a new sage, Fan Zeng, who will help players gain Epiphany into the deep mysteries hidden within the Relics.[/p][p]2) After understanding the Relic Mysteries, the corresponding exclusive ability will be unlocked for the player.[/p][p]3) After deciphering the core mysteries of each Relic, you will unlock the season-exclusive Combat Items.[/p][p]There are three season-exclusive Combat Items this season：\[Marvel·Heavy Armor], \[Marvel·Pursuit], and \[Marvel·Mandate].[/p][p]\[Marvel·Heavy Armor]：After use, the Overlord Armor protects you, granting immunity to Ranged attacks for 120 sec.[/p][p]\[Marvel·Pursuit]：After use, automatically lock onto the player with the highest Loadout Score in the match for 240 sec. Your damage dealt to that player increases by 15%.[/p][p]\[Marvel·Mandate]：Use it to obtain the quest series \[Trace of Treasures]. Complete all quests to receive a secret crate reward.[/p][p]Seasonal Combat Items cannot be traded at the Trading Market. At the end of the season, Fan Zeng will leave, and all related research progress and abilities will reset. Combat Items already obtained will be retained. Exclusive Combat Items from previous seasons can still be used this season, but can no longer be crafted or redeemed. Seasonal Combat Items being crafted when the season changes will be automatically canceled.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Newly Added Collectibles[/p][p]Newly added 6 collectibles：\[Silver Overlord Armor], \[Map of Dugang], \[Imperial Crimson Pearl], \[Annals of Lü Buwei], \[Su Qin's Insignia], and \[Taigong's Six Secret Teachings]. Each collectible has its own Examine Emote![/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Escort Codex Update[/p][p]Outside matches, spend Void Coins to open the \[Hongmen Volume] and obtain various extraction equipment and items, with a chance to draw the limited-edition weapon skin \[Xu Furen Blade]![/p][p] [/p][p]VII. A Taste of the Journey[/p][p]Taste ignorance, doubt, greed, anger, and pride; savor bitterness, sourness, sweetness, spice, and salt![/p][p]Event Duration：Oct. 22nd, 2026 Update - Nov. 4th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) During the event, complete Daily Quests and Weekly Quests to earn the limited-time item, Snack Charm. [/p][p]1) Extended the slash range of Yoto Hime's charged Vertical Strike move during her Ultimate and increased the damage of her Ultimate's finishing move \[Lacerate]. \[Combat Insight] can now be accumulated again after a short delay following its use.[/p][p]2) \[Ultimate·Advancement] enhancement：Extends the slash range of \[Lacerate] and increases the number of slashes.[/p][p](2) Adjusted the environment：Slightly reworked the arena, adding a more open central plaza and slightly increasing the density of surrounding buildings to focus combat on the central area and create a more balanced battlefield.[/p][p](3) Optimized spawn points：Made spawn locations more random and added more buildings for cover to reduce situations where one side is pinned down in its spawn area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Out-game Adjustments[/p][p]Casual Mode Adjustments[/p][p]1. Please refer to future announcements for its return date.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. After installation, use the \[Resource Manager] button to download or delete resource packs.[/p][p]2. In-game, go to \[Settings] - \[Download Settings] to view resource packs by game mode and download or delete them.[/p][p]3. After deleting a map resource pack, you will no longer be able to select that map for Matchmaking. Deleted resource packs can be downloaded again through the menus above. The map will become selectable again once the download is complete.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. New Equipment

1) New Celestia Polesword：Sumeru[/p][p]Arcane：Earthshaker Slash[/p][p]Changed the three-stage charged Horizontal Strike and the Horizontal Strike following a pommel strike.[/p][p] [/p][p]2) New Immortal Treasure Staff：Cloudsoar[/p][p]Arcane：Havoc in Heaven[/p][p]The Vertical Strike following onslaught or Heaven Uproar becomes Stanchion·Rising Cloud.[/p][p] [/p][p]3) New Celestia Kaleidoscope Parasol：Calm the Storm[/p][p]Arcane：Kaleidoscope·Parasol·Deflation[/p][p]Parasol-form Kaleidoscope·Flux will apply \[Deflation]

Newly added \[Spirit Seal·The Powderkeg][/p][p]· While \[Mech Mayhem：Co-pilot] is active, enhanced cannon hits restore additional Energy.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. In-Match Gameplay Optimizations

Old Sophora Adjustments and Optimizations[/p][p]1) Adjusted Old Sophora's Level-2 blessing trigger thresholds to 2 million /3.6 million /5 million for Tranquil Path/Perilous Path/Doomed Path, respectively.[/p][p]2) Added a multi-select button for offerings to Old Sophora.[/p][p]3) Moved the former Level-2 blessing effect, "Chance to find additional Relics when opening a new container," to Level 1 and adjusted its values accordingly.[/p][p]4) Newly added a Level-2 blessing effect. Slightly reduced the extra drop weights of \[White Emperor Crate·Legendary] obtained from solving Nightglow Pearl puzzles, defeating the Terracotta General, awakening Liu Bang, and defeating the Snake Guardian on the Stormchant map, reallocating them to other events. Training Ground Optimizations：Newly Added Forge Function[/p][p]Showdown Adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. Slightly extended the Counter windows for Vajra, Almighty General, and Thunder Lord.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Potential System Optimizations[/p][p]1. Changed \[Upgrade] to \[Upgrade to Max Level]. When enough Potential Points remain, the current Potential will automatically be upgraded to the maximum level. The single-level upgrade function remains available.[/p][p]2. After the season reset, all heroes' Potential Plans will reset to the default Potential Plan. Players whose plans have already been reset will not be affected during the current season.[/p][p][/p][p] I. NARAKA: BLADEPOINT PC FSR 4 Support Extended to RX 6000 Series — Full Coverage of RX 9000/7000/6000 Series[/p][p]1. FSR 4 is AMD's machine learning-based super-resolution technology that reconstructs lower-resolution images into high-quality visuals with clear details and smooth edges. Previously, players using AMD Radeon RX 9000 and RX 7000 series graphics cards could already enable FSR 4 in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT. items.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update –October 8th, 2026
items.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA： BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Oct. 8th, 2026 23：00 (UTC) to Oct. 9th, 2026 04：00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows：[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][h2][b]I. The Legend of Qin Crossover Game Mode[/b][/h2][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th Update - Nov. 4th 20：00 (UTC)
1. Crescent Moon Valley Battle
"The hoofbeats never cease in Crescent Moon Valley, and the Qin soldiers are already closing in. The only choice now is to draw your sword and fight your way out in a bloody battle..."
1) In the Survival Modes (excluding Immortal War) and Rift Traversal mode, \[Moonfall Gate] will appear some time after the match begins. Once activated, players can interact to teleport to \[Crescent Moon Valley]. \[Moonfall Gate] supports only 2 teams of players and will close after some time.
2) Entering \[Crescent Moon Valley] via \[Moonfall Gate] lets you challenge a special in-match stage： protect Tianming, fight a bloody battle against the Qin soldiers, and rout all enemies. The shorter the time taken, the richer the rewards.
3) When a player's HP is nearly depleted, it will instantly be restored to full, but each trigger lowers Attack; this effect lasts for a period of time.

2. Whimsical Melody Chest
During the crossover, a "Whimsical Melody Chest" will appear in Survival Modes (excluding Immortal War) and Rift Traversal mode. By attacking and interacting, players can decipher the chest's mechanism to earn rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Showdown Event Stages \[Suffer No Demon] Return![/p][p] [/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 00：00 (UTC) - Nov. 3rd, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. During the event, access the event stage from the Showdown map. Complete challenges to earn limited Hero Badges, Exhilarating Elixirs, Skyfall Cataclysm Souljade Choice Gift, and more.[/p][p]2. Sense level difference does not apply in event stages. The event has two chapters：[/p][p]· Picking up "Manticore Soul·Stone" in the "Lion's Roar" stage makes the Airborne Vertical Strike trigger falling rocks.[/p][p]· Picking up "Manticore Soul·Thunder" in the "Thunder Trial" stage infuses Defuse (Counterattack) and Aegis-break Martial Skill with Divine Thunder Waves.[/p][p]3. Event stages have their own Souljade drops, suitable for farming specific Souljades. Both chapters share the same drops, including： \[Pyreheart], \[Venom Tempering], \[Primal Starfall], \[Ice Ring Break], \[Thunder Rove], \[Star-Shattering Force], \[Polesword·Blistering Edge][/p][p](4) Each chapter has two difficulty stages that consume different amounts of Fatigue, but all stages share the same Souljade drop rates. Choose difficulty based on your capabilities.[/p][p]5. Chapter 1 stages are available immediately upon the event starting, while Chapter 2 stages unlock on Oct 20th, 2026 20：00 (UTC), at which point Chapter 1 stages will be closed.[/p][p]6. Event stages offer trial access to Inor Wan, Kurumi, Justina Gu each with preset Souljade builds.[/p][h2][b]III. Limited-time Events： [/b][/h2][p]1. All Under Heaven[/p][p]Among the hundred schools, only the valiant reigns supreme.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 28th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]1. During the event, open stashes in the Survival modes, search for supplies in Rift Traversal, or play Showdown or Casual Mode each week to obtain Fragments of the Legend;
Up to 400 Fragments of the Legend can be obtained each week. The first refresh time is Oct 14th, 2026 at 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]2. Submit the required number of Fragments of the Legend to increase Alliance and claim progress reward;[/p][p]3. Accumulate Alliance to unlock sealed chapters of The Legend of Qin.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. All-Devouring Maw[/p][p]He feasts where war is loud, and finds his fill in play.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 26th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. During the event, choose 1 of 3 modes each day to gain the corresponding mode's Buff 1 time. Complete a quest to gain 1 additional Buff use. Claimed Buff uses are valid for the current day and reset the next day.[/p][p]2. During the event, complete the required number of quests to claim corresponding rewards.[/p][p]3. Once a Buff is selected each day, it cannot be changed that day. Choose according to your preferred mode.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Dawnless Night[/p][p]Night unfurls its thousand shadows; one sword splits the dark to dawn.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 20th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.[/p][p]2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.[/p][p]3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Dew Bazaar[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Oct. 15th, 2026 20：00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]1. The Dew Bazaar will hold a limited-time sale on \[Hadi·Skyhunter Morning Dew Gift]. Use to unlock Hadi's Outfit \[Urban Hunt·Skyhunter], Hairstyle \[Urban Hunt·Wild], and Avatar \[Urban Hunt·Hadi].[/p][p]2. The first round of sales will start at 12：00 (UTC) on Oct. 9th, 2026. After 48 hours have passed, the second round will begin with another restock. 
Up to 1 may be bought per player.[/p][p]3. Using the gift pack more than once will earn you Spectral Silk on subsequent uses.[/p][p]4. For details on the number of items and other information, check the in-game event page.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Moon-Blessed Pass[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Dec. 30th, 2026 Update[/p][p]Event Rules：[/p][p]Purchase the Moon-Blessed Pass to get valuable rewards![/p][p]1. Purchase the Pass to instantly get Tara Gan's Priestess of Birth Outfit, Hairstyle and Accessory[/p][p]​2. Purchase the Pass to instantly get 10 Vouchers, totaling 2,000 Gold off, including 1 Moon-Blessed Rebate Voucher (600 Gold off orders over 1500), 2 Moon-Blessed Premium Vouchers (400 Gold off orders over 1800), 2 Moon-Blessed Joy Vouchers (200 Gold off orders over 600), and 5 Moon-Blessed Mini Vouchers (40 Gold off orders over 120). Note： Vouchers cannot be stacked, and only one voucher can be used per item.[/p][p]​3. Bond Rebate： Unlock Wei Zhuang, Ge Nie, and Crimson Lotus outfits (including Packs) to achieve the bond, with a total return of 600 Gold.[/p][p]​4. Points Reward： Unlocking direct-purchase Collection items included in the item pool will accumulate progress at a 1：1 ratio based on the standard price.[/p][p] [/p][p]​6. Baize Farm[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 Update - Dec. 30th, 2026 00：00 (UTC)[/p][p]​In the Devourer Season, Baize Farm will be reset, and last season's Seasonal points and items will be cleared. Players can choose two of last season's Celestia and Prowess to inherit their levels to this season.[/p][p]​Update Content：[/p][p]​(1) Added two new farm crops： Mushroom and Blueberry.[/p][p]​(2) The farm will see Weather changes, and different Weather provides corresponding bonus or penalty effects for each crop.[/p][p]​(3) Baize's Nexus effect has changed, now Shortens the restoring time after crops are stolen.[/p][p]​(4) Added Prowess - Thunderstruck Wood, Prowess - Auto Fertilizer, and Celestia - Best Wish Knot. Specific effects can be viewed in the gameplay guide.[/p][p]​(5) Some existing Prowess or Celestia have gained Weather Effects, providing extra bonuses under different Weather.[/p][p] [/p][p]7. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #10[/p][p]With swords in hand, free and bold while exploring the world, unrestricted and unhampered. 3rd PlayStation® Tournaments #10 are available for a limited time![/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 at 20：00 (UTC) - Nov. 4th, 2026 at 20：00 (UTC).[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Cloud Medal - OCT. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows：[/p][p]1st place： 300 Medals[/p][p]2nd place： 200 Medals[/p][p]3rd-4th place： 100 Medals[/p][p]5th-8th place： 50 Medals[/p][p]Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.[/p][p]Time[/p][p]Server       Mon to Fri   Sat   Sun (UTC)[/p][p]NA 03：00 23：00 03：00[/p][p]AS 11：00 07：00 11：00[/p][p]SEA 11：00 07：00 11：00[/p][p]EU 19：00 15：00 19：00[/p][p] [/p][p]Start Time of the First Tournament：[/p][p]NA： Oct. 10, 2026 03：00[/p][p]AS： Oct. 10, 2026 11：00[/p][p]SEA： Oct. 10, 2026 11：00[/p][p]EU： Oct. 10, 2026 19：00[/p][p] [/p][p]8. PlayStation Challenge[/p][p]Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #31 is now open![/p][p]Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.[/p][p]How to participate：
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.[/p][p]Event Duration： Oct. 9th, 2026 00：00 (UTC) - Nov. 4th, 2026 23：59 (UTC)[/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Kurumi[/p][p]​1. For \[Purified Circle： Rapid], the follow-up effect was originally a 30% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds; adjusted to a 30% Damage Reduction for 8 seconds, and restores 10 Health per second.[/p][p]II. Tianhai[/p][p]1. The Damage Multiplier for slamming a single enemy has been increased from 3.75 to 4.0.[/p][p]​III. Cyra[/p][p]​1. The damage of the first- and second- stage tracking beams of Ultimate \[Light's Mercy] has been adjusted from 1.5/2.5 to 1.8/2.7 respectively.[/p][p]​2. Simplified the control mechanism of \[Aureole： Attach], removed the choice of Horizontal Strike or Vertical Strike while aiming, and changed it to a fixed release of an orb that lasts 4 seconds.[/p][p]​3. The healing amount of \[Aureole： Attach] for Cyra / teammates has been adjusted from 300/360 to 300/420.[/p][p]​4. For \[Aureole： Attach], when the character with the orb is moving, the orb explosion now damage enemies in a wider range. Additionally, an enemy struck by a Common Attack shortly after being dazzled will remain dazzled.[/p][p]​IV. Matari[/p][p]​1. \[Invisible Assassin]'s Invisible duration has been adjusted from 12 seconds to 15 seconds, and now additionally provides the whole team with a 10% attack bonus for 20 seconds.[/p][p]​V. Tara Gan[/p][p]​1. \[Fate Rewritten]'s Glyph duration has been adjusted from 18 seconds to 20 seconds.[/p][p]VI. Feria Shen[/p][p]​1. For the Ultimate \[Mech Mayhem], the Bronze Mech's enhanced cannon damage has been increased from 3.2 to 3.5.[/p][p]​VII. Xunhuan Li[/p][p]​1. For the Skill \[Petal Knives] and Ultimates \[Untouched Leaf] and \[Untouched Leaf： Flow], under Resolved stance, using a Horizontal Strike or Vertical Strike could now fire Flying Knives, instead of merely using the Skill.[/p][p]​VIII. Ziping Yin[/p][p]​1. Increased the continuous Rage cost of the Ultimate \[Saving Grace]. When cast at full Rage, the duration is adjusted from 24 seconds to 20 seconds;[/p][p]​2. Decreased the continuous Rage cost of the Ultimate \[Saving Grace： Aegis]. When cast at full Rage, the duration is adjusted from 16 seconds to 18 seconds;[/p][p]​IX. Zenda Wu[/p][p]​The following adjustments have been made to the derived Skill \[Penetrating Arrows] of the Ultimates \[Spiritbound Bow] and \[Spiritbound Bow： Duskfall].[/p][p]​1. The Damage Multiplier of the Horizontal Strike move after drawing the bow against marked enemies has been adjusted from 3.3 to 3.2.[/p][p]2. The stagger time caused by the Vertical Strike move after drawing the bow is reduced.[/p][p]​X. Shayol Wei[/p][p]​1. \[Justiciar's Guard]'s counter now only deals a single instance of damage to enemies whose positions overlap.[/p][p]​XI. Anassa Nangong[/p][p]​1. In Ultimate Status, Jumping while grappling and sliding no longer triggers Threadwalk.[/p][h1][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Katana Adjustments[/p][p]​Added： During the startup of Katana's Charged Attack, taking a melee weapon attack will trigger a powerful counter \[Reverse Blade Slash].[/p][p]​II. Congeneric Skill System Adjustments[/p][p]1. Now, Congeneric Skill can only be used after equipping the Souljade \[Switch·Radiance].[/p][p]​2. Optimized the release of Congeneric Skills： When a weapon is equipped and its Congeneric Weapon is in the Bag, you can press the number key of the equipped Congeneric Weapon's slot after an attack or while charging to release a Congeneric Skill.[/p][p]3. Dual Blades, Dual Halberds, Spear, Staff, Greatsword, and Polesword can all release Congeneric Skills while charging.[/p][p]​4. The Congeneric Skills of Dual Blades, Dual Halberds, Spear, and Staff can all block the opponent's Common Attack or Charged Attack; a successful block allows the release of a powerful attack.[/p][p]5. Reduced the startup frames and recovery frames of all Congeneric Skills.[/p][p]6. A successful block with a Congeneric Skill now applies Recovery to yourself.[/p][p]7. All Congeneric Skills' Charged Attacks will be upgraded to Gold Focus after a certain period of time.[/p][p]​8. Resonance Strikes no longer Clash with Common Attacks.[/p][p]9. Added a visual effect indicator when blocking other attacks by realeasing a Congeneric Skill.[/p][p]10. Optimized the Congeneric Skill gestures for Dual Blades, Dual Halberds, Spear, and Staff.[/p][p]​11. Increased the declaration speed of 'Instant Execution' for Katana and Heng Sword Congeneric Skill[/p][p]​12. Increased the stagger caused by Short-handle Weapon Resonance Strikes.[/p][h1][b]Wanchu Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]​I. Water Combat[/p][p]​1. Optimized the Charged Attack gesture while diving.[/p][p]​2. While diving, Dodge no longer increases Momentum level; instead, the Charge process gradually increases Momentum level.[/p][p]​4. While diving, hold to jump/Crouch to continuously ascend/descend. Speed gradually increases and is affected by Momentum level.[/p][p]​5. In underwater Moves, pressing Jump no longer uses 'Turn Back'.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Water Hero Combat Optimizations[/p][p]​1. All Heroes gain increased swimming speed after activating Ultimate Status. Tarka Ji, Akos Hu, and Xunhuan Li receive an additional bonus to swimming speed while in Ultimate Status.[/p][p]​2. [/p][p]​Talismans fired by Wuchen's Ultimate \[Tai Chi Teleport： Blade Storm]
[/p][p]​Auric Swords fired by Lyam Liu's Ultimate \[Metal Fusion], and Auric Cores fired by the Ultimate \[Metal Fusion： Core][/p][p]​Light Orbs fired by Cyra's Ultimate \[Light's Mercy][/p][p]​3. Justina Gu's Ultimate slightly increases the freeze duration inflicted on underwater enemies.[/p][p]​7. Map Gameplay[/p][p]​1. Adjusted the layout of some Windstride Tethers in Valley of the Colossus.[/p][p]​2. Picking up Stingtail Fish, Angelfish, and Azure Finch Fish from the Scene and placing them in the Bag will automatically convert them into varying amounts of Dried Sea Fish; Azure Wave Coralline will no longer respawn, while Violet and Golden Flame Coralline will automatically convert into varying amounts of Coralline Branch. An additional opening round has been added to the Tidehidden Cave in the Tidewater Channel each match; four are opened each round.[/p][p]​5. Optimized the spawn locations of Sea Urchins, Boiling Sea Springs, Pufferfish, Spirit Clams, and Tide Fish.[/p][p]​6. Increased movement speed after activating a Boiling Sea Spring.[/p][p]​9. Optimized the structure of the Pillars in the Chaotic Realm of Yang Scene.[/p][p] [/p][p]​IV. Scene Adjustments[/p][p]​1. Beautified the landscape structures in some areas of the Scene.[/p][p]​4. Fixed several locations in the Scene where movement was not smooth.[/p][p]​5. Simplified some structures in the main city of Valley of the Colossus; merged some buildings in the main city of Wave Fort.[/p][h1][b]Souljade Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Greatsword Souljades[/p][p]​1. Staff Souljades[/p][p]​1. \[Jabbing] The timing during the move at which it can be interrupted with the Grappling Hook has been delayed.[/p][p] [/p][p]​IV. Heng Sword Souljades[/p][p]​1. Enhanced the visual effect indicator when using \[Aerial Dash].[/p][p] [/p][p]​V. Fistblades Souljades[/p][p]​1. Enhanced the visual effect indicator when using \[Sky Punch].[/p][p]​2. \[Tempest Kick] Purple Focus timing slightly advanced.[/p][p]​3. In The Evolution, the Damage Multiplier of the first two hits of the Technique \[Tempest Kick·Chill] has been decreased from 0.79*2 to 0.7*2.[/p][p] [/p][p]​VI. Fan Souljades[/p][p]​1. \[Wild Windspout] The startup frames are slightly reduced.[/p][p] [/p][p]​VII. General Melee Souljades[/p][p]1. Added the Souljade \[Switch·Radiance]： allows the use of Congeneric Skill.[/p][h1][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. [p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 16th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 17th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Casual Mode: Martial Artist Duel·Competition[/p][p]· In Martial Artist Duel·Competition, every Hero's initial Rage will start at 100%.
· The competition will be played in a best-of-five format. The first player to win three battles is the winner.
· Players need to select the Heroes and weapons they will use in the preparation phase before the match. The same heroes and weapons can't be selected.
· The winner of each battle must be decided within a certain period of time. If both players are still standing at the end of the battle, then: 
   (1) The player who deals more damage wins;
   (2) If the above values are the same, the player with the higher remaining Health and Armor wins;
   (3) If they are still the same, the player who deals damage to the opponent first wins. 
· Each player's Health, Armor, and Skill CDs will be reset after each battle.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Limited-time Event:[/p][p]1. Dueling! 0924[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2026 Update - Oct. 8th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Participate in the events to earn Chaser's Cards. The Chaser's Cards you earn count toward both your personal progress and server-wide progress.[/p][p](2) Collect 1,400 Chaser's Cards to claim all personal progress rewards.[/p][p](3) After the tournament ends, a limited-time sign-in event will begin, offering a large number of Chaser's Cards and exclusive rewards. items.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update –September 3rd, 2026
items.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 2nd, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 3rd, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]I. Showdown Season 6.0: Sandforge[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]1. New Hero Inor Wan[/p][p]Forged in storm to cleave the wind.[/p][p]Inor Wan has joined Showdown! He arrives with an all-new skill and ultimate, unlike those in the Survival modes![/p][p] [/p][p]2. New Boss and New Chapter[/p][p]Forged from the crimson sand, veiled in serpent shadows. Herald Elder Vasshani's thousand‑year obsession is yours to awaken.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Brand New Souljades and Potentials[/p][p]The Qi Mastery Art can either enhance Elemental Burst effects or call down Meteor Rain from beyond the skies to devastate enemies. This update adds seven Souljades: \[Pyreheart], \[Venom Tempering], \[Primal Starfall], \[Ice Ring Break], \[Thunder Rove], \[Star-Shattering Force] and \[Polesword·Blistering Edge], and adjusts Potential effects to bring richer match options for every Hero.[/p][p]\[Pyreheart]: Elemental Crit Rate +30%, Move Damage -5%[/p][p]\[Venom Tempering]: Number of \[Toxified] stacks required to trigger an area strike -2. Elemental Accumulation Rate +60%.[/p][p]\[Primal Starfall]: Elemental Crits additionally summon a \[Meteor Strike], leaving a \[Meteor] at the impact point. When a \[Meteor] is hit by an Elemental Strike, it triggers \[Starburst]. Each \[Meteor] can only trigger this once.[/p][p]\[Ice Ring Break]: When a monster's Frostbite meter is full, triggers an extra Ice Ring Strike. Elemental Accumulation Rate +30%.[/p][p]Souljade \[Polesword·Blistering Edge]: \[Polesword]'s enhanced charged moves carry extra Elemental Accumulation.[/p][p]\[Thunder Rove]: Divine Thunder can be Countered, but its damage -50%. Countered Divine Thunder is reflected in a straight line, dealing a Round-Trip Strike. Elemental Accumulation Rate +60%.[/p][p]\[Star-Shattering Force]: After triggering \[Starburst], your Attack +20% for 15 sec.[/p][p]New Rare Attribute \[Sortilege]: Increases the chance to roll the Critical Hit determination twice and take the better result[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]4. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss Reset[/p][p]Season Challenge progress and rewards of Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss have been reset. Saves of Nirriti's Ruins have been cleared.[/p][p]Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Showdown Seal, limited-edition avatars, and much more![/p][p] [/p][p]5. Souljade Recast Updates[/p][p](1) Added "Spirit Essence" progress to the Recast[/p][p]· Each attribute or value recast grants 1 Spirit Essence. At 120 Spirit Essence, claim 1 Flux Shard in the Recast interface.[/p][p]· The progress bar in both attribute and value recast interfaces shows current Spirit Essence and the required amount for the guarantee.[/p][p]· Spirit Essence can exceed 120, and all accumulated rewards can be claimed at once.[/p][p]· After the update, existing rare attribute guarantee counts will convert to Spirit Essence at a 1:1 ratio.[/p][p] [/p][p](2) Souljade Essence Recast[/p][p]· A new tab has been added to the value recast interface, allowing switching between "Normal Recast" and "Souljade Essence Recast."[/p][p]· "Souljade Essence Recast" consumes 1 "Jade Essence Crystal" to greatly increase a Souljade's attribute values, roughly equivalent to 40 Normal Recasts (excess beyond the cap refunds materials proportionally). If used on a rare attribute, its value is directly raised to the cap.[/p][p]· "Jade Essence Crystal" can be obtained by completing any Showdown stage with Fatigue, or by completing Showdown weekly quests.[/p][p]· Each use of \[Jade Essence Crystal] for attribute Recast grants Spirit Essence equal to the corresponding increase.[/p][p] [/p][p](3) Rare Attribute and Attribute Value Adjustments[/p][p]· Attribute Recast no longer produces rare attributes[/p][p]· Souljades dropped from Showdown stages, and attributes obtained via Imbue with "Shrouded Jade," will now have values randomized within 50%–60% of the cap. Values near the cap will no longer appear.[/p][p]//Dev Note: The goal of this Recast rework is to improve the progression experience:
1. With Spirit Essence, you no longer need to think about recast order, it lowers both the learning curve and cost.
2. The new \[Jade Essence Crystal] cuts down on Souljade hoarding, making inventory management easier. It also eliminates the need to check every drop's stats after each match.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Season Journey Quest Rewards Upgraded[/p][p]Season Journey Quests have been updated. After completing the beginner's Journey Quests, participate in Showdown to automatically unlock the Journey Quest of the current season.[/p][p]Within the limited event period after the season begins, complete any Showdown stage daily to claim daily rewards. Complete 7 days of quests to receive generous Journey rewards including a "Souljade Selection Gift" and the valuable "Legend Jade."[/p][p] [/p][p]7. Weekly Quest Optimization and Reward Upgrades[/p][p](1) It is no longer required to complete all weekly quests. items.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 13th, 2026
items.contents:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p] [/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 12th, 2026 23:00 (UTC) to August 13th, 2026 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p] [/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][h2][b]I. The King's Avatar Crossover casual mode: Dual-Phase Brawl[/b][/h2][p]Peak of glory, fight to the top! Heroes rise — write the next legend of The King's Avatar in the arena and team battles![/p][p]1. Claim the training skills rewards for The King's Avatar Account Card via Event Center - A Single Fire Spark - Character Training;[/p][p]2. Select the The King's Avatar account card you wish to bring into the match.[/p][p]3. Choose Arena Match or Team Battle.[/p][p]Arena Match:[/p][p]· Players fight in turn; the winner stays to continue.[/p][p]· Each win grants a Buff to teammates in Team Battle.[/p][p]· 1v2 and 1v3 victories award bonus points.[/p][p]· After Arena Match ends, join the Team Battle for the final clash.[/p][p]Team Battle:[/p][p]· Players revive infinitely; eliminating enemies earns points.[/p][p]· Consecutive eliminations / eliminating Bounty target grant bonus points.[/p][p]· The Spirit Well appears at intervals; capturing it grants generous rewards.[/p][p]4. Both battles contribute to the same score. The faction with the higher total score wins.[/p][p]5. Based on match results and game performance, earn event Score Rewards from Event Center - A Single Fire Spark - Dual-Phase Brawl.[/p][h2][b]II. Showdown's New Event Mode: Skyfall Cataclysm[/b][/h2][p]Chaos descends on Lin'an. The Nexus Gate opens. Heroes raise their blades to cut down the Enchanted, dispel the darkness, and restore peace to the mortal world.[/p][p]1. Basic Rules[/p][p]Chaos seeks to corrupt Lin'an City. Heroes must wipe out monsters under the pressure of the chaotic Shadow Corruption, grow stronger, and finally pass through the Nexus Gate to defeat the Enchanted boss within and dispel the chaotic corruption.[/p][p]Some Showdown heroes are available in this mode. None of the Showdown out-of-game progression carries into this mode.[/p][p]· Each match randomly assigns a weakness to the final Enchanted Boss (weak to Melee/Element/Ranged). Plan your route based on your spawn location, the Boss's weakness, and the resource stronghold drop tendencies for that match.[/p][p]· Clear an entire resource stronghold or defeat an Elite/Boss monster to obtain Souljades from stronghold chests. These Souljades apply to your in-match gear.[/p][p]· Defeat monsters to gain EXP and raise your team Level. Each resource stronghold has a recommended Level, attacking one above your team Level will be extremely difficult.[/p][p]· The Realm of Eclipse appears after a set time each match. Challenge the boss inside for generous rewards! If you fail, well... there's always the next run![/p][p]· In the late game, a Nexus Gate leading to the final Enchanted Boss appears within the safe zone. Watch the timer and head there. As Shadow Corruption spreads, the area will be affected as well.[/p][p]· There are also some surprise items in the scene waiting to be discovered![/p][p]2. Out-of-Game Progression[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm progression only takes effect in this mode.[/p][p]· Complete matches or quests to earn "Calamity Crystals", used in the Skyfall Fateboard system to unlock fateboards and boost strength.
· Defeating monsters may also yield "Lingering Artifacts". One artifact can be activated per match for powerful extra effects.[/p][p]3. Fatigue and Drops[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm boosts only take effect in matches, but Fatigue can still be spent to obtain various Showdown progression materials and secure the current version's top-tier set immediately.[/p][p]Skyfall Cataclysm offers two difficulties with different Fatigue costs, but Souljade drop rates are the same across all stages.[/p][p]Obtained after the first clear:[/p][p]\[Threefold Gathering], \[Four Spirits Converge], \[Thunderpull], \[Thunderproof][/p][p]Stage drops:[/p][p]\[Element Surge], \[Thunder Charge], \[Forsaken Force], \[Tempered Force], \[Dual Spirit Marks], \[General·Sap][/p][p]Plus three new \[Move] Souljades, which in the current version can only be obtained from Skyfall Cataclysm (effects vary by Souljade element):[/p][p]\[Spear·Azure Dragon Break]: The Vertical Strike after Spear Horizontal Finishers, a missed Dragonslayer, or a missed Heartstopper Kick changes, and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. A Dodge after a Perfect Dodge or Defuse (Counterattack) hit can also chain into Azure Dragon Break with increased damage.[/p][p]\[Katana·Thunderstorm]: Alters Katana's charged Horizontal Strikes and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. A Dodge after a Perfect Dodge or Defuse (Counterattack) hit can also chain into Thunderstorm with increased damage.[/p][p] [/p][p]\[Dual Blades·Octa-Slash Blade]: Alters the Dual Blades' Vertical Strike after a charged attack and deals extra Frostbite Accumulation. During Octa-Slash Blade move, Dodge and launch a Vertical Strike to continue the Octa-Slash Blade move. A Perfect Dodge instantly unleashes the finishing blow.[/p][h2][b]III. Limited-time Events[/b][/h2][p]1. All Tribulations Fade[/p][p] [/p][p]With a steadfast heart, face all eighty-one trials[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 13th, 2026 Update - Sep. 2nd, 2026 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p](1) Complete daily quests to obtain Passage Scrolls. Submit them to retrace the Journey to the West and unlock rewards.[/p][p](2) Each submission yields a Violet-gold Bowl with rewards like Myriad Treasure*5, Serene Treasure Choice Gift*5, Imprint Roller, and Kite![/p][p] [/p][p]2. Formless Heavenfall[/p][p] [/p][p]As calamity looms and shadows fall, heroes draw their blades and rise.[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 13th, 2026 Update - Aug. 26th, 2026 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]1. Complete quests during the event to claim rewards.[/p][p]2. There are 5 quest sets, unlocking one after another daily upon the event start.[/p][p]3. Quests must be completed in order, and completing all 5 sets will grant the full event rewards.[/p][h2][b]IV. Official Team Shopping[/b][/h2][p]Event Duration: Aug. 27th, 2026, 04:00 (UTC) - Sep 9th, 2026, 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, joining the presale builds Server Cheer Point. The higher the cheer point, the lower the final price, up to the max discount.[/p][p]2. During the presale, pay a 240 Gold deposit for \[The Harvest Matron Pack] and claim the presale bonus: Serene Treasure Choice Gift*1.[/p][p]3. When the item goes on sale, presale ends. Presale players must pay the remaining balance at the final discount price to get the item. Note: If the balance is not paid before the event ends, the deposit will not be refunded.[/p][p]4. Players who miss the presale can buy the item at the final discount price when it releases, but will not receive the Presale Bonus.[/p][p]5. During the official Team Shopping period, the event page closes after purchase.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hero Adjustments[/p][p]I. Ye Xiu[/p][p]1. Adjusted the duration of the \[Unspecialized Blitz: Soaring Dragon] Ultimate in Trios mode from 22 sec to 25 sec. No changes in Solo and Duos modes.[/p][p]2. For the \[Unspecialized Blitz] Ultimate: while in Ultimate state, Cannon form non-enhanced Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.3/1.5 to 1.2/1.3, and Cannon form enhanced Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.3/1.8 to 1.2/1.3
Cannon-form Charged Attacks can no longer stagger Blue Focus Strikes.
Scythe-form Charged Attack damage adjusted from 1.5/1.0 to 1.5/1.5[/p][p]3. Counterstrike Combo performed while in the Ultimate state now grants a 65% recovery effect based on the damage dealt.[/p][p]4. The knockback strike when Ye Xiu casts \[Soaring Dragon] will no longer trigger Shayol Wei's \[Black Tortoise Block].[/p][p]5. Slightly increased the starting speed and horizontal jump speed while charging and moving in Ultimate state.[/p][p] [/p][p]//Dev Note: Currently, Ye Xiu's \[Unspecialized Blitz] tends to overperform by staying in Cannon form, dealing excessive damage. We have made balance adjustments to the Cannon and Scythe forms, hoping to encourage Ye Xiu players to make better use of different weapon forms when using his Ultimate \[Unspecialized Blitz].[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Yoto Hime[/p][p]1. Optimized the input window for \[Flying Edge] following an Uppercut Slash.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Yueshan[/p][p]1. Optimized the Almighty General's performance in water.[/p][h1][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Kaleidoscope Parasol[/p][p]1. \[Kaleidoscope·Parasol]
Increased the damage area of its Charged Horizontal Strike; hitting a downed enemy now launches them airborne.
2. \[Kaleidoscope·Shield]
Increased the damage area of the 2nd-stage Horizontal Strike.[/p][p]3. \[Kaleidoscope·Axe][/p][p]Increased the damage area of its Charged Horizontal Strikes[/p][p]4. Optimized the animation of the Quick Counter.[/p][p]5. Optimized the moving distance of the charged Vertical Strike while sprinting.[/p][h1][b]Water Combat Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]1. Ascending no longer launches you out of water upon reaching the surface; instead, you will stay in the water surface.[/p][p]2. Using Dodge during Ascending or Descending will no longer trigger a special dodge.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue where repeatedly tapping Space while Ascending to the water surface could accidentally trigger a Double Jump.[/p][p]4. Optimized the animation when taking damage while on the water surface.[/p][p]5. Attack moves on the water surface now are the same as those performed when diving.[/p][p]6. Added a 2nd Horizontal Strike for the Water Skimming state.[/p][p]7. Optimized the visual effects of Ascend and Descend.[/p][p] [/p][p]In-game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Easy Battle[/p][p]The following Omens have been adjusted in Survival Mode:[/p][p](1) Business Acumen: Changed from a fixed 500 Dark Tide Coins every 10 sec to 100/300/600, with the amount increasing over time as the match progresses.[/p][p](2) Soothing Boon: New effect — melee weapon attacks have a high chance not to consume durability.[/p][p](3) Battle Ready: Armor changed from Common to Rare; new effect — Omens also apply upon Rebirth.[/p][p]II. Specialized Practice[/p][p]1. Added \[Ye Xiu - Unspecialized Blitz·Soaring Dragon] practice in Free Training.[/p][p]III. Wanchu Adjustments[/p][p]1. Added a new weather condition, Starry Night.
